notes:
Patch 0.1.2

Updates
- Apply waits until Manafall has actually closed, then copies files and starts the game again.

Online
- Patch notes sit below Host / Join / Back. The notes box scrolls with the mouse wheel or the scrollbar.

Friends
- Open chat and hit Friends. Add nearby players or remove people already on your list. The list is saved on this machine.
- Friends and people in your voice/chat group get a name over their head. It shows through walls and terrain out to about 180 m (Social settings can push that farther, up to 200 m).

Join
- A hosted game listens on IPv4 port 7777 so another PC can actually connect, not only see the name on the list.
- If Join fails, the Online Join panel says so. The usual cause is Windows Firewall blocking TCP 7777 on the host.
- Hosting asks Windows to allow TCP 7777, TCP 8787, and UDP 8788 on Private and Public.

Internet
- Host looks up this PC's public IPv4 and copies address:7777 to the clipboard.
- If the router allows UPnP, Host opens 7777 (and 8787) for friends outside the house.
- If UPnP is off, the host overlay tells you to forward TCP 7777 to this PC.

LAN
- Same house network still uses the Join list (UDP 8788). Paste the LAN address if the list is wrong.
